note: Adapted from Chhotani (1997), entry 215 (p. 384); the alate is recorded as Unknown in the original, so only the soldier and worker are covered; synonyms and references are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow to yellowish brown; antennae pale yellow; thorax, legs and abdomen yellow-white; mandibles dark brown to black, the right mandible paler. Head sparsely pilose, body more densely pilose. Body length 5.70–7.20. Head capsule nearly rectangular, length slightly less than twice the width (length to mandible base 1.97–2.50, width 1.17–1.36); sides nearly parallel; posterior margin rounded, sometimes slightly incurved in the middle; coronal suture extending from the posterior margin to the middle of the head. Fontanelle transversely slit-like, opening into a small duct and a large gland, situated anteriorly (1.80–2.03 from the posterior margin). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 about as long as segment 2. Labrum asymmetrical, longer than wide, anterolateral corners pointed, anterior margin incurved (length 0.35–0.46, width 0.23–0.30). Mandibles asymmetrical, slightly shorter than the head capsule: left 1.80–2.06, right 1.75–2.13. Left mandible twisted, outer margin of the basal half incurved, apex with a weak beak, inner margin with one tooth and one basal projection at 1/4 from the base; right mandible blade-like, straight and pointed at the apex. Postmentum elongate and rod-like, waist between the widest point and the posterior margin (length 1.07–1.23, maximum width 0.37–0.40, waist width 0.20). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.23–0.33, width 0.70–0.80), anterior margin weakly concave in the middle, posterior margin slightly convex.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head and antennae pale yellow; thorax and legs cream white; abdominal tergites and sternites transparent, greyish due to intestinal contents. Pilosity of head and body of medium density. Body length about 4.00–5.00. Head capsule nearly circular, wider than long (length to mandible base 0.87–0.93, width 1.03–1.10). Fontanelle plate large, translucent, circular (diameter 0.12–0.14). Eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 about as long as segment 2, or slightly longer or slightly shorter; segment 4 shorter than or about equal to segment 3. Postclypeus pilose, strongly inflated, length slightly less than half the width, divided into two halves; anterior margin straight, posterior margin convex. Anteclypeus subtrapezoidal, transparent and hairless. Labrum domed, with a few hairs near the anterior margin. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.23–0.28, width 0.53–0.63), anterior margin without a notch.
